properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive dependency: hash.js@1.1.7 is required by elliptic@6.4.1 (package-lock.json:658, itself transitive under secp256k1/ethereumjs-util). Its SHA-2 implementations ship in the build. No call site in the application — the app's own hashing goes through ethereumjs-util (Keccak) and web3.sha3. Available in the shipped library; no call site found in the application.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: MD5 ships inside crypto-js@3.1.8, a transitive dependency of web3@0.19.1 (package-lock.json:2746) — the bridge's Ethereum client. web3@0.19 uses crypto-js for SHA3/Keccak hashing only; no MD5 call site in this application. Available in the shipped library; replaceable only by upgrading the web3 dependency chain.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto-js@3.1.8 is web3 0.19.1's crypto layer and is REACHABLE from the application through web3.sha3() (lib/bridge-util.js:271, Keccak-256). Its SHA-1 path itself has no call site in this application.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 is not merely shipped but ACTUALLY USED by this application through wrappers: ECDSA-secp256k1 transaction signing via ethereumjs-tx (lib/bridge-tx-manager.js:46-47) and pubkey/address derivation via ethUtil.privateToAddress (lib/bridge-util.js:38,132). The curve is fixed by the Ethereum protocol — changeable only ecosystem-wide, not per-application; reported separately as live call-site findings.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: bcrypt-pbkdf@1.0.2 (OpenSSH bcrypt_pbkdf key derivation) is a transitive dep required by sshpk@1.16.1 (via request@2.81.0 → http-signature), used by sshpk for OpenSSH private-key passphrase handling. All four sites are the same dependency declared in two lockfiles. Ships with the build; the application itself never calls it. Changeable only by upgrading the request/sshpk chain.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive dependency shipped in the tree via browserify-aes (the browserify crypto shim); no call site found in the application — the bridge keeps its account keys as plaintext hex in a JSON key file (bridge-util.js:47-53) and never uses browserify-aes or an encrypted keystore. Available in the shipped library.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@0.14.5 (own entry package-lock.json:2652) is required by sshpk@1.16.1 (request's HTTP-signature stack) and bcrypt-pbkdf. Ed25519 available in the shipped library; no call site found in the application.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Live signing path: the app signs Ethereum transactions with ECDSA over secp256k1 at lib/bridge-tx-manager.js:47 (tx.sign via the ethereumjs-tx wrapper); elliptic@6.4.1 sits inside that chain (secp256k1@3.6.2 → elliptic, reached through ethereumjs-util@5.2.0 → ethereumjs-tx@1.3.7). Quantum-unsafe under Shor; migration to ML-DSA-65 is protocol-bound — the EVM mandates secp256k1 ECDSA, so this is replaceable only at the Ethereum protocol level, not in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.4.1 provides ECDH over secp256k1 as part of the shipped dependency tree (dep of secp256k1@3.6.2). Available in the shipped library with no key-agreement call site in this application — the app only signs transactions (bridge-tx-manager.js:47). Quantum-unused capability in a live branch of the dependency tree.

properties.value: AES ships inside crypto-js@3.1.8 (transitive dep of web3@0.19.1); the application has no AES call site — web3@0.19 uses crypto-js for SHA3/Keccak only. Available in the shipped library; no call site in the application. Quantum-unsafe algorithms in a dormant dependency branch; replaceable only by upgrading the request/sshpk chain.

properties.name: pqs:context

This is the build's shipped crypto library.

properties.value: elliptic@6.4.1 is a live transitive dependency in the transaction-signing chain (secp256k1@3.6.2 requires elliptic ^6.2.3, package-lock.json:2360; secp256k1 is required by ethereumjs-util@5.2.0 → ethereumjs-tx@1.3.7 used at bridge-tx-manager.js:47).
